Author: JustPixelll
Name: All My Glams
Punchline: Your glamour, Glamourer and Penumbra outfit workspace.
Description: Build equipment-only glamour designs, capture and apply looks through Glamourer, keep a local wardrobe and favourites, browse existing Glamourer designs, and manage equipment-affecting Penumbra mods from one UI.
Changelog: v0.2: Live complete-look Dresser; explicit None slots; Revert to Game; unified Wardrobe; automatic Glamourer/Penumbra refresh; external equipment sync; safer naming/override rules; and first cached Eorzea Collection individual-glamour import.
